APIProxy.name: a2a-dispatch-v1
APIProxy.DisplayName: East-West A2A Sovereign Agent Dispatch Proxy
APIProxy.Description: Enforces per-caller API Product authorization (VerifyAPIKey), KVM-driven caller KSA JWT subject pinning (KeyValueMapOperations + VerifyJWT), and per-caller A2A rate limits (Quota) before dispatching A2A JSON-RPC over TLS 1.3 + client mTLS to TargetServer gdcso-agent-ingress.
